授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
海洋生物学分野・水産増殖学分野・アクアフィールド科学分野の３研究室が担当する。実験開始の具体的な日時はMoodleに記載するので注意すること。

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本実験では、脊椎動物（魚類）、海産無脊椎動物、及び藻類について解剖・顕微鏡標本作成、形態観察・顕微鏡観察・画像解析を経て水産科学研究に必要な技法を学び知識を習得する。本実験を通じて、脊椎動物、無脊椎動物の構造上の共通点と相違点についての理解を深めるとともに、藻類を含めた水産生物学への興味を深めてもらうことを目的の一つとしている。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This laboratory experiment uses marine vertebrates (fish), invertebrates, and algae. Students will acquire the essential knowledge and techniques required for aquaculture science through anatomy, morphological observation, and image analysis. The aims are for students to deepen their understanding of the structural similarities and differences between vertebrates and invertebrates, as well as to develop their interest in aquaculture science, including algae.
<Marine Biology Laboratory>
-To learn a basic method of preparation of specimens for microscopy
-To investigate at the microscopic level the organization and function of tissues and cells of fish
-To learn reproductive organs, sex differentiation, and reproductive process in fishes
[Aquafield Science Laboratory]
-To investigate the organization and function of tissues in vertebrates (fish) and invertebrates (e.g., gills, digestive system, kidney) at the macroscopic level
-To learn a basic method of image analysis
<Fisheries Biology Laboratory>
-To understand the mechanical structure and the functions of a light biological microscope, and to acquire the practical skills necessary for observing the fine structures of living cells
-To deepen understanding of the biodiversity of various algal lineages by observing marine and freshwater environments, as introduced in the lecture class (Phycology I)
